name: Flare Screen
idea: After you pass, a teammate screens your defender, and you drift away from the ball to the open wing for a shot.
why: After a pass, your defender turns to watch the ball and steps toward it. A flare screen blocks the way back, so you can drift away to the other wing where nobody is. Defenders expect cuts toward the ball, not away from it.
tryit: Pass to the wing, then wait for the screen. Fade away from the ball, back toward the 3-point line, with your hands ready to catch.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top, {2} is on the wing, and {4} is by the free-throw line.
{1} passes to {2}. {X1} turns to watch the ball and steps toward it.
{4} runs up and sets a screen on {X1}, on the side away from the ball.
*Flare:* {1} drifts away from the ball to the other wing. {X1} bumps into {4} and gets stuck!
{2} throws the ball all the way across to {1}.
Swish! A flare screen takes you away from the ball, to where nobody is.
